label: Agronomic Prior Modifiers (Expert Rules)
disclaimer: Expert-rule priors to be validated with an agronomist. Applied as transparent multipliers on the base statistical forecast.

none.label: No spray / No intervention
none.description: Baseline natural pest dynamics with no chemical or botanical suppression.

botanical_neem.label: Botanical / Neem formulation (Azadirachtin)
botanical_neem.description: Mild antifeedant and oviposition deterrent; 30% suppression lasting ~5 days.

neonicotinoid.label: Neonicotinoid (e.g., Imidacloprid, Acetamiprid, Thiamethoxam)
neonicotinoid.description: Systemic sucking-pest control with ~65% knockdown lasting up to 14 days; secondary resurgence risk thereafter.

organophosphate.label: Organophosphate (e.g., Acephate, Dimethoate)
organophosphate.description: Broad-spectrum contact/ingestion action with ~60% knockdown lasting ~10 days.

pyrethroid.label: Synthetic Pyrethroid (e.g., Cypermethrin, Lambda-cyhalothrin)
pyrethroid.description: Rapid knockdown with ~7 day residual; may flare sucking pests by suppressing natural predators.

other.label: Other Registered Insecticide
other.description: Generic chemical treatment assumed ~50% population suppression for 10 days.

tolerant_hairy.description: Dense leaf trichomes (pubescence) physically hinder jassid stylet penetration and oviposition (-12% pressure).

susceptible.description: Glabrous or susceptible leaf canopy facilitates rapid nymph establishment (+15% pressure).

bt.description: Bt (Cry endotoxin) targets lepidopteran bollworms; does not confer sucking pest resistance (neutral).

non_bt.description: Non-Bt conventional cotton; neutral to sucking pests.

low.description: Low plant nitrogen reduces leaf succulent amino acid pools, slightly discouraging leafhoppers (-5%).

high.description: Excess vegetative nitrogen promotes lush, tender leaf tissue highly attractive to sucking jassids (+12%).

okra.description: Adjacent Okra (Bhendi, Abelmoschus esculentus) is a major Malvaceae reservoir host for jassid migration (+15%).

brinjal.description: Adjacent Brinjal (Eggplant) serves as an active secondary host harbouring jassid populations (+10%).

none.description: No major solanaceous or malvaceous crop reservoirs nearby (neutral).

rainfed.description: Neutral (input recorded for future longitudinal modeling).

drip.description: Neutral (input recorded for future longitudinal modeling).

flood.description: Neutral (input recorded for future longitudinal modeling).
